notes.title: Content Release #2
notes.content:
With the game just releasing in just over 2 weeks time, Content Release is back and here is what will be featured. Remember to Wishlist the game today, helps out alot.

Prison
Committing crimes can be risky as you may be arrested. For example there is a slight chance that your inventory will be randomly searched, which can be an issue if you are in possession of illegal items, such as drugs, materials ect. Another reason that you can be sent to prison is if you don't repay credit & loans. Once imprisoned you will not be able to get a job as you have a criminal record, and your inventory & businesses will be taken away.

Bank Heist
If you complete all the quests, you will be able to start the bank heist setup. Do a task and receive the planning documents, where you will need to work for the cartel so that they can provide you with the equipment to pull of the heist. Be careful, you could get imprisoned.

notes.title: Content Feature #1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first content feature. Here are a few features that will be available from Launch.

Businesses
You can buy businesses such as Shops, Tech Shops, PC Shops, Factories ect. Once you buy the business, you will be able to manage it and make money from it. Once you save you will keep the business. Some businesses require active management such as inputting resources into it to keep it running, or active management. 
Gangs
You can start a Gang if you buy it for $25,000. Once you bought the "business" you can name your gang and start managing it. You put money into the homebase balance which will allow you to hire gang members. With your hired gang members, you can send them to attack other gangs territories and take it for yourself, or you can send them to defend one of your territories (other gangs can attack your territory if it is doing well). You can sell drugs to your territory which is based on the "Drug Popularity" which will determine the chance of your drugs selling. Be careful, too much gang activity can get your gang busted by the DEA.
Drugs
You can cook drugs and sell them either to your gang territories or to the Illegal Vendor. You will gain more money from selling to territory rather than selling to the illegal dealer. During random searches, if you have illegal items (drugs included) you will be sent to prison.
Credit & Loans
If you are struggling with money, you can take a loan which you will have to pay back in 5 minute increments and in 5 instalments. If you fail to payback your loan, your businesses will be taken and your freedom will be taken (you will be sent to prison). 
You can use your Credit Card to take credit, which will amount the more money you spend on credit. You will then have to pay back your credit. If you don't pay it back within a given time frame, you will be jailed and your businesses will be taken. 
Hacking Studios
You can buy a Hacking Studio where you use Personal Information Cards to hack victims bank accounts. You will need to input the right commands into the console in order to gain access, which means that there will be many obstacles to completion. 

That's it for now, stay tuned for more.
The Official Trailer is coming very soon, so stay tuned for that. (release date!)
Wishlist the game now on Steam.
